name: Admin
overview: Admin is a male figure mentioned in the lineage of the Messiah, as recorded in Luke 3:31. While his tribal affiliation and additional notes are not specified, his placement in this genealogy highlights his role in the ancestral line leading to Jesus Christ. This positions him within the biblical narrative as part of God's providential plan for redemption.
namesAndTitles: The name Admin appears as a proper name in Luke 3:33. There is no special meaning or divine origin indicated for this name in the provided information, so it is presented plainly as a personal name without further elaboration.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Admin is the son of Amminadab, an inferred relationship, and the father of Ram, explicitly stated in Luke 3:33. These connections place him within a direct paternal line, contributing to the genealogy of Christ as preserved in the New Testament.
scriptureSignificance: Admin's significance lies chiefly in his inclusion in the Messiah's genealogy, affirming the historical and theological continuity from Old Testament ancestors to Jesus Christ. His presence in this lineage underscores the fulfillment of God's promises through a real human ancestry. Although little else is noted about his life or deeds, his role as a link in the genealogical chain serves to authenticate the Messianic descent documented in Luke.
